topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can't even start to tell you how much I can't believe they just did this. A surprise party, they said. It was going to be perfect, you know? All our friends, the music, the cake... And now it's just, what? Poof, gone? How could they just call it off like it was nothing? We were going to make it special, remember all the things we planned? It's not just a party, it's about being there when it counts. This is so not okay. We need to do something, we just can't let this slide. We’ll make our own plans, even better. Come on, we can do this.
